description: This Java class 'SequencedIdToEnv' implements an entity operation that generates sequence IDs and stores them into an environment map, as specified by a custom XML element '<sequenced-id>'. It manages sequence name, field access, staggers, and whether to fetch long IDs, integrating with the OFBiz entity framework.

classes.name: SequencedIdToEnv
classes.description: Implements the '<sequenced-id>' element for generating and storing sequence IDs into the environment map.

classes.name: SequencedIdFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of SequencedIdToEnv.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the sequence ID retrieval and places the value into the environment map based on configuration.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this operation, including its configuration parameters.
